panels.title: Data status of the sources used
panels.description: First and latest timestamp per table, age of the latest value and approximate row count. Status compares the age with the update cadence of the source: OK within the expected age, LATE up to 3x, STALE beyond; 'static' tables are not updated any more.

options.content:
**Forecast error** = actual minus ENTSO-E day-ahead forecast for the bidding zone DE_LU (hourly means of the 15 min values). Load error positive = more load than forecast; wind/PV error positive = more generation than forecast. The **residual load error** = load error - wind error - PV error: positive means more residual load than forecast, i.e. a shortage that balancing energy or intraday trading must cover (POS demand), negative a surplus (NEG).

**Balancing**: regelleistung.net aFRR energy market (Regelarbeit, 15 min products, area DE) averaged per hour. The published *average* energy price is the average over the complete merit order list (all offers, not only activated ones) and *min* is the cheapest offer; activation volumes and activation prices are not in the data, so the relation to the error is indicative only. Many offers sit at the +/-15000 EUR/MWh cap, which makes averages large. Capacity prices are the aFRR capacity auction results (4 h products).

The default range is Q1 2025; all sources used here are available continuously.

panels.title: Mean absolute residual load error
panels.description: Mean absolute hourly forecast error of the residual load (load - wind - solar) of DE_LU over the time range, MW.

targets.rawSql:
WITH l AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', "index") AS t, avg(actual_load) AS load FROM entsoe.query_load WHERE $__timeFilter("index") AND country = 'DE_LU' GROUP BY 1),
lf AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', "index") AS t, avg(forecasted_load) AS load_fc FROM entsoe.query_load_forecast WHERE $__timeFilter("index") AND country = 'DE_LU' GROUP BY 1),
g AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', "index") AS t, avg(coalesce(wind_onshore,0) + coalesce(wind_offshore,0)) AS wind, avg(solar) AS pv FROM entsoe.query_generation WHERE $__timeFilter("index") AND country = 'DE_LU' GROUP BY 1),
gf AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', "index") AS t, avg(coalesce(wind_onshore,0) + coalesce(wind_offshore,0)) AS wind_fc, avg(solar) AS pv_fc FROM entsoe.query_wind_and_solar_forecast WHERE $__timeFilter("index") AND country = 'DE_LU' GROUP BY 1),
e AS (SELECT t, l.load - lf.load_fc AS load_err, g.wind - gf.wind_fc AS wind_err, g.pv - gf.pv_fc AS pv_err,
  (l.load - lf.load_fc) - (g.wind - gf.wind_fc) - (g.pv - gf.pv_fc) AS res_err, l.load, lf.load_fc, g.wind, gf.wind_fc, g.pv, gf.pv_fc
  FROM l JOIN lf USING (t) JOIN g USING (t) JOIN gf USING (t))
SELECT avg(abs(res_err)) AS v FROM e

panels.title: aFRR energy prices vs residual load error
panels.description: Hourly aFRR energy market (Germany): average energy price of the bid list for POS and NEG products (EUR/MWh, left; capped bids make it large) against the residual load error (MW, right axis). Large positive errors (shortage) are expected to coincide with high POS prices and large negative errors (surplus) with low NEG prices. Sources: regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelarbeit, entsoe.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ar AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', (delivery_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') + (substring(product from 5)::int - 1) * interval '15 minutes') AS t,
    avg(average_energy_price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE product LIKE 'POS%') AS pos_avg, avg(average_energy_price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE product LIKE 'NEG%') AS neg_avg,
    avg(min_energy_price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE product LIKE 'POS%') AS pos_min, avg(min_energy_price_eur_mwh) FILTER (WHERE product LIKE 'NEG%') AS neg_max,
    avg(sum_of_offered_capacity_mw) FILTER (WHERE product LIKE 'POS%') AS pos_off, avg(sum_of_offered_capacity_mw) FILTER (WHERE product LIKE 'NEG%') AS neg_off
  FROM regelleistung.afrr_ergebnisse_regelarbeit WHERE $__timeFilter(delivery_date) AND area = 'DE' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t,$__interval), avg(pos_avg) AS "POS average price EUR/MWh", avg(neg_avg) AS "NEG average price EUR/MWh", avg(pos_min) AS "POS cheapest offer EUR/MWh" FROM ar GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: POS cheapest offer vs residual load error (hourly)
panels.description: Each point is one hour: residual load error (x, MW) against the cheapest POS aFRR energy offer of the hour (y, EUR/MWh). The cheapest offer is the first bid activated; a positive relation means a shortage pushes activation into more expensive offers. Hourly means of quarter hour values.

gf AS (SELECT date_trunc('hour', "index") AS t, avg(coalesce(wind_onshore,0) + coalesce(wind_offshore,0)) AS wind_fc, avg(solar) AS pv_fc FROM entsoe.query_wind_and_solar_forecast WHERE $__timeFilter("index") AND country = 'DE_LU' GROUP BY 1),
e AS (SELECT t, l.load - lf.load_fc AS load_err, g.wind - gf.wind_fc AS wind_err, g.pv - gf.pv_fc AS pv_err,
  (l.load - lf.load_fc) - (g.wind - gf.wind_fc) - (g.pv - gf.pv_fc) AS res_err, l.load, lf.load_fc, g.wind, gf.wind_fc, g.pv, gf.pv_fc
  FROM l JOIN lf USING (t) JOIN g USING (t) JOIN gf USING (t))
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t,'1d'), avg(abs(res_err)) AS "mean |residual load error| MW" FROM e GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Mean absolute forecast error (MW) of load, wind, solar and residual load by local hour of the day over the time range. Solar errors peak around noon, residual load errors are largest in the morning and evening ramps. Source: entsoe.
